title: Axios
description: A promise-based HTTP client for browser and Node.js.

data.text: Axios is a popular HTTP client that works in both browser and Node.js environments. It provides a simple API for making HTTP requests and handles many common tasks automatically, such as JSON transformation and request cancellation.

data.title: Installation
data.content: Install Axios using npm or yarn.
data.code:
npm install axios
# or
yarn add axios

data.title: Basic GET Request

terms.definition: Axios returns promises, making it easy to use with async/await.
Middleware that runs before a request is sent or after a response is received.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Axios simplifies HTTP requests in JavaScript
It works in both browser and Node.js
Supports interceptors, cancellation, and automatic JSON parsing
data.takeaway: Axios is a reliable choice for HTTP requests in modern JavaScript applications.
